collection.title: Porsche Panamera 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche Panamera 2016 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Porsche Panamera 2016 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
